title: 哪些食物对狗狗有害？
author: Sharafat Ali
content:
Dogs are curious animals, and many of them will happily eat almost anything offered to them. However, just because a food is safe for humans does not mean it is safe for dogs. Some everyday foods can cause mild https://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/organ damage, or even death.

As a responsible dog owner, it is important to know which foods should never be given to a dog and which foods should only be given in small amounts. A https://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/ human foods should only be occasional treats when they are known to be safe.

  1. Chocolate

Chocolate is one of the most well-known foods that is dangerous for dogs. It contains substances called theobromine and caffeine. Dogs https://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/

Dark chocolate and baking chocolate are generally more dangerous because https://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/ Eating chocolate may cause vomiting, diarrhea, excessive thirst, restlessness, rapid heart rate, tremors, seizures, and serious poisoning.

Never intentiohttps://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/nally give chocolate to a dog. If a dog eats a significant amount, especially dark or baking chocolate, contact a veterinarian as soon as possible.

  1. Grapes and Raisins

Grapes and raisins can be extremely dangerous for dogs. In some dogs, even a relatively small amount may cause serious kidney damage or kidney failure.

The exact amount that causes poisoning can vary between dogs, which makeshttps://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/ small amount is safe.

Symptoms may include vomiting, diarrhea, tiredness, loss of appetite, increased or decreased urination, and weakness. If your dog eats grapes or raisins, veterinary advice should be sought immediately.

  1. Onions and Garlic

Onions and garlic can damage a dog's red blood cells and may lead to anemia. They can be harmful whether they are raw, cooked, dried, or powdered.

Garlic and https://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/soups, sauces, seasoning mixes, takeout meals, and snacks. This means that even food that does not obviously contain pieces of onion or garlic may still be unsafe for dogs.

Symptoms may include weakness, pale gums, tiredness, vomiting, and breathing difficulties. https://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/

  1. Xylitol

Xylitol is a sweetener found in some sugar-free gum, candy, baked goods, https://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/ It is also sometimes listed under a different name, such as birch sugar.

Xylitol can cause a dangerous drop in blood sugar in dogs and may also cause severe liver problems. Symptoms can develop quickly and may include vomiting, weakness, difficulty walking, tremors, seizures, and collapse.

Always check thehttps://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/or product that may contain sweeteners.

  1. Alcohol

Alcohol is toxic to dogs. Even relatively small amounts can cause https://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/ to alcohol than humans.

Dogs should never be given beer, wine, liquor, or foods containing alcohol. Alcohol may cause vomiting, disorientation, poor coordination, https://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/

Alcohol-containing products should also be stored safely away from pets.

  1. Coffee, Tea, and Caffeinated Drinks

https://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/ be dangerous for dogs. Dogs are much more sensitive to caffeine than people.

Caffeine poisoning may cause hyperactivity, restlessness, rapid breathing, an increased heart rate, abnormal heart rhythms, tremors, seizures, and other serious symptoms.

Coffee grounds and coffee beans can also be hazardous if eaten.

  1. Cooked Bones

Many people https://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/s, but cooked bones can be dangerous. Cooking makes bones more likely to splinter.

Sharp pieces of bone can injure the mouth, throat, stomach, or intestines. They may also cause choking, internal injuries, or intestinal blockages.

Never give a dog cooked chicken bones, cooked fish bones, or other cooked animal bones without appropriate veterinary guidance.

  1. High-Fat and Greasy Foods

In some dogs, especially those that are sensitive, high-fat meals can contribute to pancreatitis. Pancreatitis is an inflammation of the https://foodblogbynaila.blogspot.com/

aiSummary: 本文列举了八种对狗狗有毒或有害的常见食物，包括巧克力、葡萄、洋葱、木糖醇、酒精、咖啡因、熟骨头和高脂肪食物，并解释了每种食物的具体风险和症状。
oneSentenceSummary: 本文列举了八种对狗狗有毒或有害的常见食物，包括巧克力、葡萄、洋葱、木糖醇、酒精、咖啡因、熟骨头和高脂肪食物，并解释了每种食物的具体风险和症状。
summary: 本文提供了一份关于在喂养狗狗时应避免的食物的全面指南。它详细介绍了巧克力的危险（可可碱和咖啡因）、葡萄和葡萄干（肾脏损伤）、洋葱和大蒜（红血球损伤）、木糖醇（低血糖和肝衰竭）、酒精（神经系统抑制）、咖啡因（心脏和神经系统影响）、熟骨头（碎裂和窒息）以及高脂肪食物（胰腺炎）。文章强调了负责任的宠物所有权，并建议在怀疑中毒时立即寻求兽医护理。

mainPoints.point: 巧克力因含有可可碱和咖啡因而对狗狗有毒，这些物质会导致严重的中毒和死亡。
mainPoints.explanation: 狗狗代谢巧克力化合物的速度比人类慢得多，导致毒素在体内积聚，影响神经系统和心脏。黑巧克力和烘焙巧克力特别危险。

mainPoints.point: 葡萄和葡萄干会引起狗狗的急性肾衰竭，即使是少量也会造成严重后果。
mainPoints.explanation: 虽然具体机制未知，但摄入后往往会导致快速的肾脏损伤，表现为呕吐、腹泻和排尿变化。

mainPoints.point: 洋葱和大蒜会破坏狗狗的红血球，导致贫血。
mainPoints.explanation: 这些食物含有氧化狗狗血红蛋白的化合物，引起虚弱和呼吸困难。无论是生、熟、干还是粉末形式，都具有危险性。

mainPoints.point: 木糖醇是一种对狗狗极其危险的糖替代品，会导致血糖急剧下降和肝衰竭。
mainPoints.explanation: 狗狗对木糖醇的反应是释放大量胰岛素，从而耗尽葡萄糖水平。这可能在几个小时内导致癫痫、昏迷甚至死亡。

mainPoints.point: 酒精对狗狗具有高度毒性，会导致严重的呼吸和神经系统问题。
mainPoints.explanation: 狗狗对酒精的耐受性很低；即使是少量也会导致醉酒、昏迷或死亡。必须将酒精饮料远离宠物。

mainPoints.point: 咖啡因和含咖啡因的饮料会导致狗狗兴奋过度和心脏问题。
mainPoints.explanation: 咖啡因会刺激狗狗的中央神经系统和心脏，导致颤抖、呼吸急促和心律不齐等症状。

mainPoints.point: 熟骨头对狗狗不安全，因为它们会碎裂并造成内部损伤或阻塞。
mainPoints.explanation: 与生骨头不同，熟骨头变得脆弱，容易碎成锋利的碎片，这些碎片会损伤消化道或导致窒息。

mainPoints.point: 高脂肪和油腻的食物会导致狗狗患上胰腺炎，引起严重的腹痛和炎症。
mainPoints.explanation: 富含脂肪的食物会使狗狗的胰腺超负荷运转，引发炎症反应。症状包括呕吐、腹泻和嗜睡。

keyQuotes: 巧克力是众所周知的对狗狗危险的食物之一。它含有可可碱和咖啡因等物质。
葡萄和葡萄干对狗狗来说可能非常危险。对于一些狗狗，即使是相对少量也可能导致严重的肾脏损伤或肾衰竭。
洋葱和大蒜会破坏狗狗的红血球，可能导致贫血。无论是生、熟、干还是粉末形式，它们都具有危害性。
木糖醇是一种甜味剂，存在于一些无糖口香糖、糖果、烘焙食品和牙膏中。它有时也被称为桦树糖。
酒精对狗狗有毒。即使是相对少量也会导致严重问题。狗狗对酒精的敏感度远高于人类。
咖啡、茶和其他含咖啡因的饮料对狗狗来说可能是危险的。狗狗对咖啡因的敏感度比人高得多。
许多人把生骨头当作零食给狗狗吃，但熟骨头却很危险。烹饪会使骨头更容易碎裂。
脂肪含量非常高或油腻的食物会给狗狗带来问题。脂肪残渣、油炸食品、油腻的肉和浓郁的酱汁都可能导致呕吐和腹泻。
